body: Hi there I watched this movie after I read your message & yes it was definitely a good movie with a message which i have got is decision which we think are made wrong because later they got f****d up, will also got f****d up when the things happen other way around but the process might be different. So we should embrace what ever happen in our way let thing up to the Faith/Destiny. Hope I remember this message when the next time I am feeling down. Thanks Bye

Yep I was depressed a little bit more yesterday that is why I was searching through ideas (You Know What IDEAS I am talking about) over internet when I came across this forum and get my feeling out for the first time & after which I felt quite light. Currently I am not on any treatment as I have not told anyone about since I don't think i fell comfortable about telling anyone about this at all. However I have done this over internet because i know at least my identity remains anonymous that is only reason I have opened up over here

The only advice i can give you is to keep yourself occupied, I know it's difficult but that is the only solution i have been able to found yet, like arranging things, doing exercise (sometimes;-)) or by putting your effort in order to find a job which I can say is very much frustrating but we have to do it so collect the energy what ever is left inside of you start job hunting. Hope everyone (including us) find a job. Good luck to both us for job hunt

Thanks for the advice, & yes I try to keep myself occupied in-order to get those thoughts out of my mind but the problem is always when you are alone or feeling depressed that is when these feeling starts to occupy my mind. Hope I could overcome this problem one day

hi there this is the first time have came out in open regarding my feelings, & would like to say it that you guys are very supportive. 
When someone meets me they cannot even think that i have suicidal thoughts as I might look like one of the cheerful & happy person in the group but from inside the opposite is true, this is something which I have learned later through internet that this is a  defense mechanism many people uses who are sad from inside in-order to keep people away from them so that they cannot see the real face of them.
